```{=html}
<p>We just received approval for a collaborative project with Mauro Galetti (UNESP, Rio Claro, Brazil), as a part of the agreement between the spanish CSIC and brazilian CNPq for years 2004-2005. We’ll focus on palm seed dispersal ecology, megafauna fruits, and comparisons of fruit-frugivore communities and keystone species characteristics in neotropical and Mediterranean habitats. It’s going to be great fun.</p>
```
